_doc: #1477 Cloud Me's project/area tabs that read like an application name (the Proj section, ui.sections[proj]). test-app-names-pattern.sh T5 exempts a page whose id AND label are one project declared here (same id, same label, same app): 'Cloud-me', 'Capital' and 'Hardtech' name the owner's projects, not the apps cloud-me, capital-* and hardtech-*. Read only by that tester; nothing in the APK reads this file (it is not an assets dir).
